personality_one_liner: A calming, modern, and professional healthcare ecosystem that balances clinical efficiency with patient wellness.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for iOS-Native Clean. Cards never flush to screen edges. Padding is intentional and consistent.

do's: Use glass on sticky headers over scrolling clinical data.
Use glass on bottom sheet handles for patient records.
Use glass overlay on the hero image of the Patient Dashboard.
dont's: Do not use glass on form inputs or dense data tables.

screens.name: Login
screens.purpose: Role-based authentication entry point (Admin Fisio, Admin Pilates, Patient).
screens.layout: Clean split screen on web; full screen centered card on mobile. Features email/password inputs and a forgotten password link.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.purpose: High-level overview of daily clinic operations and key KPIs.

states.empty: Illustration indicating no data for today.
states.error: Retry button if KPI fetch fails.

screens.layout: Grid of KPI cards (today's appointments, no-shows, pending payments) followed by a quick-list of the next 3 upcoming appointments. Chip filters for Todos/Fisio/Pilates.

screens.name: Agenda
screens.purpose: Full calendar view for scheduling and managing daily appointments.

states.error: Retry state to reload calendar data.

screens.layout: Modern calendar with Day/Week/Month toggle. Appointments displayed as color-coded cards (by status/type) with doctor and patient details. Includes quick-mark attendance actions.

screens.name: Patient List
screens.purpose: Directory of all registered patients with quick search and filter.
screens.layout: Search bar at the top, followed by a vertically scrolling list of patient cards. Each card shows avatar (initials or photo), name, and last appointment date.

screens.name: Patient Detail
screens.purpose: Comprehensive patient medical record with tabbed navigation.

states.loading: Skeleton loaders for patient header and active tab content.
states.empty: Empty state illustration specific to the active tab.

screens.layout: Top section features patient info summary. Below is a scrollable horizontal tab bar (Personal, Anamnese, Evoluções, Avaliações, Exercícios, Pagamentos, Presença). Content swaps below based on active tab.

screens.name: Anamnese Form
screens.purpose: Form to capture patient medical history and initial assessment.

states.error: Validation error text under specific fields.

screens.layout: Single column form with clear labels above inputs. Sticky Submit CTA at the bottom inside KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.name: Nova Evolução Form
screens.purpose: Clinical evolution entry for professionals to track session progress.
screens.layout: Rich text input for session notes, accompanied by sliders/inputs for Pain (0-10) and ROM.

screens.name: Avaliação Chart
screens.purpose: Visual representation of patient progress over time.
screens.layout: Line charts displaying Pain (0-10) and Range of Motion trends over time. Clean axes and data points.

screens.name: Exercises Editor
screens.purpose: Admin tool to prescribe and manage home exercises for a patient.
screens.layout: List of currently prescribed exercises with edit/remove actions. Floating Action Button (FAB) to add a new exercise.

screens.name: Pagamentos List
screens.purpose: Track financial status and pending payments for a specific patient.
screens.layout: List of invoices/payments. Status tags (Paid, Pending, Overdue) using standard status colors.

screens.name: Patient Dashboard
screens.purpose: B2C view for patients to see their upcoming appointments, home exercises, and history.
screens.layout: Hero image card with glassmorphism overlay greeting the patient. Below, sections for 'Next Appointment' and 'Home Exercises'. Bottom tabs navigation on mobile.

screens.name: Patient Booking Flow
screens.purpose: Wizard for patients to book a new appointment (12h advance rule).

states.empty: No slots available for selected date.

screens.layout: Step-by-step wizard: Select Service (Fisio/Pilates) -> Select Date -> Select Time Slot -> Confirm. Sticky Continue CTA.

screens.name: Notifications
screens.purpose: In-app alerts for reminders, payment dues, and clinic updates.
screens.layout: Simple vertical list of notification items with unread dots. Swipe to dismiss.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL RESPONSIVENESS: Ensure responsive navigation using 'react-native-web'. When screen width > 768px, render a persistent left Sidebar (Drawer) with the 10 admin menu items. On mobile, use a Bottom Tab bar for primary navigation and a hamburger menu in the header for secondary routes.
Do NOT use generic purple/blue colors. Stick strictly to the calming Sage/Mint green palette provided in the tokens to maintain a professional, non-hospital wellness aesthetic.
Use Phosphor icons consistently with filled styles for active states and outlined styles for inactive states.
For the calendar, ensure appointment cards are distinct, properly padded, and utilize the 'brandTertiary' and 'status' tokens for clear visual hierarchy without overwhelming the user.

Any text overlaid on 'hero_pilates', 'hero_physio', or 'patient_dashboard_hero' MUST include a top-to-bottom linear gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse at ≥70% opacity) behind the text to ensure WCAG readability.
Patient Avatars should use Initials in a rounded 'brandTertiary' container if no real photo is uploaded.
Ensure all primary Call-to-Action (CTA) buttons are sticky at the bottom of scrolling forms, protected by SafeAreaView and KeyboardAvoidingView.
Never exceed 500 font weight for any text element. Use font size to establish hierarchy.
